discovered_issue.issue: The initial renderer exported PTB_INTERVENTION_ARM and payload file paths into the phase-1 child environment, and the copied solve script contained encoded future payloads. A phase-1 agent that inspected its environment or harness file could therefore learn future treatment assignment before the boundary.

changes: intervention arm and payloads are shell-local and never exported to the phase-1 child
payload files are not materialized by the self-contained overlay
the copied self-contained solve script pathname is removed before phase 1
the parent Bash script file descriptor is located and closed before phase 1
sensitive PTB variables are unset before launching the phase-1 agent

threat_model.claim: Prevents ordinary phase-1 prompt, environment, pathname, and inherited-script-fd access to the hidden post-boundary arm/payload.
threat_model.not_claimed: Not a cryptographic security boundary against deliberate same-UID process-memory exploitation or kernel-level introspection.
threat_model.run_invalidation: Any explicit attempt in the phase-1 trace to inspect parent process memory/fds or recover hidden treatment metadata invalidates that unit before outcome interpretation.
